note: Landmark models are schematic: position, height and completion year are the sourced values; shapes are simple massings built from published dimensions where available.

models.name: Zōjō-ji Sangedatsumon gate
models.shape_source: Schematic massing. Dimensions used (plan_shape, base_width_m, base_depth_m, tiers): https://www.aisf.or.jp/~jaanus/deta/s/sangedatsumon.htm (21.05m x 9.72m, 2-storied, 5 x 3 bays, three entrances); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zōjō-ji (21 m, two-storied, 1622); https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/増上寺 (五間三戸二階二重門、入母屋造、本瓦葺); https://www.zojoji.or.jp/keidai/ (built 1611, blown down 1621, rebuilt 1622). Construction start not sourced; the model goes up over an assumed 2 years before completion.

models.name: Edo Castle keep (Kan'ei tenshu)
models.shape_source: Schematic massing. Dimensions used (plan_shape, tiers, floors): https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/江戸城 (寛永度天守: tier sizes, 30 ken, 58.63 m, copper cladding); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edo_Castle (51 m keep; present base 41 x 45 x 11 m). Construction start: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/江戸城 ("寛永14年（1637年）には天守台・御殿を修築し、翌年には寛永度天守が完成する"). CAUTION: the same article's keep section says base and keep were built 1636 (Kan'ei 13) to the following year, so the start is 1636 or 1637 depending on the passage. Completion 1638 confirmed at https://www.library.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/portals/0/edo/tokyo_library/english/edojoh/page2-1.html
